title: Czechia – Stadium construction work – Zimní stadion - malá hala
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je výstavba objektu malé haly, která bude sloužit jako tréninkový zimní stadion doplňující funkci stávajícího velkého zimního stadionu v Olomouci. Navrhovaná stavba má sloupový konstrukční systém, nosné sloupy, průvlaky a střešní vazníky. Ty jsou nad zázemím prefabrikované z vyztuženého betonu, výjimkou jsou velké střešní vazníky nad ledovou plochou, které jsou ocelové. Opláštění je tvořeno sendvičovými panely s předsazenou fasádou - na štítových stěnách z hliníkových lamel, boční stěny jsou opatřeny předsazenou fasádou z vlnitého plechu. Na všech fasádách je umístěno pásové prosklení různých výšek. Samotné zastřešení bude tvořené trapézovým plechem s hydroizolačním a tepelně izolačním souvrstvím, nad zázemím je nosná vrstva tvořena prefabrikovanými betonovými panely a střecha je opatřena vegetačním souvrstvím a extenzivní zelení. Na střeše bude instalována technologie FVE (celkový výkon 22 kWp). Řešený objekt má zastavěnou plochu 3 946,5 m2 a obestavěný prostor 54 302 m3. Výška hřebene hlavní hmoty je + 12,410 m. Ledová plocha 26×60 m je tvořena chlazenou železobetonovou deskou, chlazení ledové plochy je přímé se čpavkem. Založení objektu je navrženo pomocí hlubinného zakládání - pilot. Součástí stavby bude mimo jiné vybudování parkoviště o kapacitě 63 parkovacích stání a promenády - plochy pro pěší mezi stávajícím zimním stadionem a nově budovanou malou halou. Před zahájením stavebních prací musí být provedena přeložka technologického kanálu pro chlazení ledové plochy sousedního zimního stadionu. Tato veřejná zakázka bude zadávána v samostatném zadávacím řízení. Bližší specifikace předmětu plnění je obsahem příslušných částí zadávací dokumentace, např. projektové dokumentace, soupisu stavebních prací, dodávek a služeb s výkazem výměr, návrhu smlouvy, atd.

description: Las denominadas Tecnologías de la Información y la Comunicación (TIC) se desarrollaron a finales del siglo pasado y son herramientas de amplia utilización desde 1995. En el entorno universitario puede afirmarse que son herramientas de utilización global (por todos los universitarios) desde finales de la década de los 90 del siglo pasado. Desde esas fechas ya no se entiende, ni puede desarrollarse normalmente, la actividad de ningún universitario (ya sea PDI, estudiante o PTGAS) sin utilizar el correo electrónico o el acceso a información a través de web, o la docencia sin las utilidades del campus virtual, etc. Y día a día van incorporándose nuevas aplicaciones que mejoran y facilitan el trabajo cotidiano de los universitarios (videoconferencia, herramientas de trabajo colaborativo, etc.) Consecuencia directa de este cambio en las condiciones de trabajo de los universitarios es que una (si no la primera) de las herramientas básicas del puesto de trabajo de cualquier universitario es su ordenador personal y sus dispositivos móviles; máquinas a través de las cuales pueden utilizarse esas herramientas de trabajo sin las que no puede desarrollarse la actividad cotidiana. La Universidad de Zaragoza precisa, por tanto, adquirir ordenadores personales y dispositivos móviles para su uso en todos sus ámbitos de actuación: docencia, investigación y gestión universitaria. Dentro de cada uno de estos ámbitos (en especial en docencia e investigación) las necesidades no son uniformes puesto que los entornos de trabajo son muy diferentes (filosofía, derecho, informática, etc.). Por otro lado, es muy difícil (por no decir imposible) planificar con suficiente antelación las necesidades de cada grupo puesto que las fuentes de financiación son diversas y no predecibles con antelación. El acuerdo marco es la forma idónea para cubrir las necesidades de la universidad puesto que permite homogeneizar las compras permitiendo que cada unidad las realice cuando sea necesario. El procedimiento está subdividido en 2 lotes: 1. Lote 1 dedicado a la adquisición de ordenadores personales con sistema operativo macOS, sus periféricos y accesorios. 2. Lote 2 incluye las tabletas (tablets en terminología inglesa) con sistema operativo IOS, cada vez de más utilización por su transportabilidad

Das Gebäude soll zukünftig nicht nur Platz für die sichere Unterbringung von Fahrzeugen, sondern auch für die Lagerung und Organisation einer Vielzahl von Ausrüstungen bieten. Zusätzlich zu den genannten Einrichtungen werden Schulungs- und Besprechungsräume bereitgestellt, nicht nur für regelmäßige Schulungen und Informationen über neue Techniken, Vorschriften und Einsatzstrategien, sondern auch für die zentrale Aus- und Weiterbildung des Feuerwehrkollegiums in der gesamten Verbandsgemeinde Trier-Land. Das Erdgeschoss sowie das Obergeschoss des zweigeschossigen Gebäudekörpers sind als massive Stahlbetonkonstruktion mit einem hohen Grad der Vorfertigung geplant. Die Fahrzeughalle soll als konventioneller Stahlbetonskelettbau ausgeführt werden. Die Trennwand zwischen Fahrzeughalle und angegliedertem Nebenraumprogramm ist als Stahlbetonthermowand vorgesehen. title: Germany – Firefighting equipment installation work – Schaumlöschanlage (VE067), CVK, DHZC
description: Die Charité - Universitätsmedizin Berlin beabsichtigt die Errichtung eines zukunftsweisenden Neubaus für das Deutsche Herzzentrum der Charité (DHZC) im südwestlichen Bereich des Campus Virchow-Klinikum (CVK). In dem geplanten Neubau werden u.a. auch die Zentrale Sterilgutversorgung (ZSVA) und die Zentrale Notaufnahme (ZNA) untergebracht sowie auf dem Dach des Gebäudes ein Hubschrauberlandeplatz errichtet. Die Gesamtnutzfläche für den Neubau DHZC beträgt ca. 29.800 m² bei einer Bruttogrundrissfläche von ca. 75.600 m² und einem Bruttorauminhalt von ca. 355.000 m³. Es ist geplant, den Neubau als Hochbau mit 16 Obergeschossen sowie 2 Untergeschossen zu errichten. Für das Gebäude wird eine Nachhaltigkeitszertifizierung nach dem System der Deutschen Gesellschaft für Nachhaltiges Bauen (DGNB) in der Stufe "Gold" angestrebt. Gem. der VdS-2108-Richtlinie wird zur Brandbekämpfung des Hubschrauber-Landeplatzes im 17. Obergeschoss eine Schaumlöschanlage geplant. Die Fläche des Landeplatzes beträgt ca. 893 m². Die Technikzentrale der Schaumlöschanlage befindet sich im 16.OG unterhalb des Hubschrauberlandeplatzes. Hier sind die Löschwasser- und Schaummittelbehälter untergebracht. Die Technikzentrale der Schaumlöschanlage ist in den Sprinklerschutz, z.B. der geplanten HDWN-Anlage mit einzubeziehen. Die Brandbekämpfung erfolgt über fernsteuerbare Löschmonitore. Die Auslösung erfolgt manuell. Eine Alarmierung im Brandfall erfolgt über die BMZ. Eine weitere detaillierte Leistungsbeschreibung ist dem LV zu entnehmen. Es bestehen gesonderte Anforderungen nach dem Berliner Ausschreibungs- und Vergabegesetz (BerlAVG), siehe Vergabeunterlagen. Nähere Informationen können den auf der Vergabeplattform der Charité (https://vergabeplattform.charite.de) zur Verfügung gestellten Unterlagen entnommen werden.

En el entorno universitario puede afirmarse que son herramientas de utilización global (por todos los universitarios) desde finales de la década de los 90 del siglo pasado. Desde esas fechas ya no se entiende, ni puede desarrollarse normalmente, la actividad de ningún universitario (ya sea PDI, estudiante o PTGAS) sin utilizar el correo electrónico o el acceso a información a través de web, o la docencia sin las utilidades del campus virtual, etc. Y día a día van incorporándose nuevas aplicaciones que mejoran y facilitan el trabajo cotidiano de los universitarios (videoconferencia, herramientas de trabajo colaborativo, etc.) Consecuencia directa de este cambio en las condiciones de trabajo de los universitarios es que una (si no la primera) de las herramientas básicas del puesto de trabajo de cualquier universitario es su ordenador personal y sus dispositivos móviles; máquinas a través de las cuales pueden utilizarse esas herramientas de trabajo sin las que no puede desarrollarse la actividad cotidiana. La Universidad de Zaragoza precisa, por tanto, adquirir ordenadores personales y dispositivos móviles para su uso en todos sus ámbitos de actuación: docencia, investigación y gestión universitaria. Dentro de cada uno de estos ámbitos (en especial en docencia e investigación) las necesidades no son uniformes puesto que los entornos de trabajo son muy diferentes (filosofía, derecho, informática, etc.). Por otro lado, es muy difícil (por no decir imposible) planificar con suficiente antelación las necesidades de cada grupo puesto que las fuentes de financiación son diversas y no predecibles con antelación. El acuerdo marco es la forma idónea para cubrir las necesidades de la universidad puesto que permite homogeneizar las compras permitiendo que cada unidad las realice cuando sea necesario. El procedimiento está subdividido en 2 lotes: 1. Lote 1 dedicado a la adquisición de ordenadores personales con sistema operativo macOS, sus periféricos y accesorios. 2. Lote 2 incluye las tabletas (tablets en terminología inglesa) con sistema operativo IOS, cada vez de más utilización por su transportabilidad

title: Hungary – Urban development construction work – Bem tér környezeti fejlesztése
description: A TOP_PLUSZ-1.3.2-23-DE1-2025-00001 azonosító számú projekt részeként a Bem tér környezeti fejlesztése. A zöldterületi rekonstrukcióba bevont fejlesztési terület nagysága az északi és déli fejlesztési területrészen összesen 12520 m2, melyből 8900 m2 a megújuló vagy újonnan kialakított zöldterület nagysága. Részekre történő ajánlattétel kizárásnak indoka: A gazdasági, műszaki, minőségi, valamint a szerződés teljesítésével összefüggő szervezési szempontok együttes, komplex vizsgálata alapján Ajánlatkérő megállapította, hogy a közbeszerzés tárgyát képező, több elemből álló zöldterületi rekonstrukciós és közterület-fejlesztési beruházás esetében a részekre történő ajánlattétel biztosítása nem egyeztethető össze a beruházás rendeltetésszerű, egységes minőségű és határidőben történő megvalósításával. A fejlesztés egy egységes koncepció mentén megvalósuló, komplex tájépítészeti és infrastruktúra-fejlesztési beruházás, amely magában foglalja a növénytelepítési munkákat, az öntözőrendszer kiépítését, a burkolatépítési feladatokat, a játszótéri és utcabútor elemek telepítését, a vízépítési jellegű beavatkozásokat (szökőkút felújítás, csapadékvíz szikkasztás), valamint a közbiztonsági rendszer (kamerák) telepítését. Ezen elemek műszakilag és funkcionálisan egymásra épülnek, egymással szoros kölcsönhatásban állnak, önálló részekként történő kezelésük a beruházás egységes működőképességét veszélyeztetné. A beruházás egyes munkanemei nem önállóan, hanem egymás kivitelezési előfeltételeként és egymásra épülő rendszerként valósulnak meg. A növénytelepítési munkák például közvetlenül kapcsolódnak az öntözőrendszer kiépítéséhez és üzembe helyezéséhez, mivel a telepített növényállomány fenntarthatósága csak az öntözőrendszer megfelelő kialakítása és beszabályozása mellett biztosítható. A burkolatépítési munkák szintén szoros kapcsolatban állnak a csapadékvíz-gazdálkodási megoldásokkal, mivel a térkő- és aszfaltburkolatok kialakítása során biztosítani kell a csapadékvíz zöldfelületek irányába történő elvezetését és szikkasztását. A játszótéri eszközök, utcabútorok, térfigyelő kamerák és egyéb közterületi berendezések telepítése ugyancsak a végleges tereprendezési, közmű- és burkolatépítési munkákhoz igazodva végezhető el. A kivitelezési folyamatok ilyen fokú összefonódása miatt a munkák szakágankénti vagy funkcionális részekre bontása aránytalan mértékű koordinációs és műszaki kockázatokat eredményezne. Ajánlatkérő a teljes beruházásra kiterjedő, egységes kiviteli tervdokumentációval rendelkezik, amely a zöldfelületi rendszer, a vízgazdálkodási megoldások, a burkolati struktúra, valamint a közterületi berendezések összehangolt kialakítását tartalmazza. A tervdokumentáció olyan integrált műszaki megoldásokat alkalmaz (különösen a növényfelületek és az öntözőrendszer kapcsolata, a burkolt felületek és a csapadékvíz-elvezetés szikkasztásos rendszere, valamint a különböző funkciójú területrészek kapcsolódása), amelyek megbontása esetén a kivitelezés koordinációja jelentősen nehezebbé válna, és fennállna a nem megfelelő illeszkedések, illetve műszaki inkompatibilitások kockázata. A kivitelezési munkafolyamatok térben és időben szorosan összefonódnak. A földmunkák, közműépítési és vízépítési feladatok, burkolatépítések, valamint a növénytelepítések egymásra épülő, egymást feltételező tevékenységek. Több kivitelező párhuzamos jelenléte a munkaterületen jelentős koordinációs többletterhet eredményezne, különösen a munkaterület-átadások, az ideiglenes forgalomtechnikai megoldások, valamint a különböző szakági munkák összehangolása tekintetében. A fejlesztéssel érintett terület jellegéből fakadóan – lakókörnyezetben elhelyezkedő, folyamatos használat alatt álló közterület – kiemelten indokolt az egységes organizáció, amely biztosítja a kivitelezés zavartalanságát, a lakossági terhelés minimalizálását, valamint a balesetveszélyes helyzetek elkerülését. A részajánlattétel kizárását indokolja továbbá, hogy a felhívásban megjelölt helyrajzi számok nem egymástól elkülönülő, önállóan kezelhető beruházási helyszíneket jelölnek, hanem a Bem tér és közvetlen környezetének egységes közterületi rendszerét alkotó, egymással fizikailag összefüggő ingatlanokat. A fejlesztés tárgyát képező zöldfelületek, burkolatok, közlekedési kapcsolatok, közterületi berendezések, játszótéri elemek, vízgazdálkodási létesítmények és közbiztonsági rendszerek egyetlen funkcionális egységet képeznek, amelynek használhatósága és rendeltetésszerű működése csak a beruházás teljes körű megvalósításával biztosítható. A helyrajzi számok szerinti vagy területrészek szerinti részekre bontás mesterséges elkülönítést eredményezne, amely sem műszaki, sem üzemeltetési szempontból nem tükrözné a beruházás valós szerkezetét. Az egyes területrészek önálló kivitelezése nem eredményezne önmagukban használható, funkcionálisan elkülönülő létesítményeket, ezért azok önálló közbeszerzési részként történő kezelése nem tekinthető ésszerűnek. Gazdasági szempontból a beruházás részekre bontása jelentős többletköltségekkel járna. Több kivitelező esetén párhuzamos organizációs költségek (felvonulási létesítmények, ideiglenes közművek, őrzés-védelem, forgalomtechnika), valamint többszöri munkaterület-átadás és -átvétel merülne fel, amelyek összességében a beruházás költséghatékonyságát rontanák. Emellett a különböző kivitelezők közötti esetleges vitás helyzetek (pl. határfelületek, felelősségi kérdések) további idő- és költségnövekedést eredményezhetnek. A beruházás területi egységéből adódóan több vállalkozó egyidejű jelenléte esetén a munkaterület-használat, az anyagmozgatás, a felvonulási területek igénybevétele és a szakági ütemezések összehangolása külön koordinációs szervezet kialakítását tenné szükségessé, amely további többletköltséget és kivitelezési kockázatot jelentene. Karakterkolát miatt folytatás a II.2.14) További információk pontban (BT-300 mező).

title: Germany – Software supply services – Bereitstellung, Betrieb (inkl. Hosting) und Support einer IT-Anwendung zur Digitalisierung der Vorgänge in Bezug auf die Trichinenuntersuchung, das Management von Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich, das Management im Falle eines Ausbruches der Afrikanischen Schweinepest (ASP) und einer Schnittstelle zur Jagdstatistik-Anwendung
description: Es soll eine IT-Anwendung zur Digitalisierung der Vorgänge in Bezug auf die Trichinenuntersuchung, das Management von Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich und das Management im Falle eines Ausbruches der Afrikanischen Schweinepest (ASP) als SaaS-Cloud-Lösung beschafft werden. Die IT-Anwendung muss kompatibel zur Jagdstatistik-Anwendung der Condition – Integrierte Softwarelösungen GmbH sein. Mit dieser werden im Freistaat Thüringen die Streckendaten (Daten der von Jägern erlegten Wildtiere) erfasst. Die IT-Anwendung soll sowohl als Web- (nutzbar in den gängigen Browsern) als auch Mobile App-Anwendung (Betriebssysteme iOS und Android) zur Verfügung stehen. Als App wird im Rahmen der Ausschreibung eine Anwendung definiert, die vor Verwendung durch den Nutzer auf einem mobilen Gerät installiert werden muss und auch nur dort genutzt werden kann. In der Regel erfolgt dies auf einem Smartphone oder Tablet mithilfe eines sogenannten App-Stores. Es wird zwei wesentliche Nutzergruppen geben: a) Verwaltungs- bzw. Labormitarbeiter b) verwaltungsexterne Nutzer (z. B. Jagdausübungsberechtigte) Die verwaltungsexternen Nutzer erfassen Daten zu erlegten bzw. geschlachteten Tieren. Erforderlichenfalls stellen diese zudem Anträge zur Untersuchung dieser Tiere auf Trichinen und/oder bestimmte Wildtierseuchen bei den zuständigen Behörden bzw. der zuständigen Untersuchungseinrichtung des Freistaates Thüringen. Die Untersuchungsergebnisse sollen über die IT-Anwendung abrufbar sein. Die zuständigen Behörden (Veterinär- und Lebensmittelüberwachungsämter der Landkreise und kreisfreie Städte - Veterinärbehörden) betreiben die Trichinenuntersuchungslabore. Diese sollen über eine eigene Nutzeroberfläche auf die durch die externen Nutzer in der IT-Anwendung erfassten Antragsdaten zugreifen und die Untersuchungsergebnisse an die Antragssteller zurück übermitteln können. Zudem soll für die zuständigen Behörden eine Laborsoftware zur Verfügung gestellt werden, mit Hilfe dieser auf Basis der Antragsdaten die Untersuchungstätigkeiten dokumentiert werden können. Im Falle der Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich ist das Labor des Auftraggebers im Thüringer Landesamt für Verbraucherschutz die zuständige Untersuchungseinrichtung. Die dort in Nutzung befindliche Laborsoftware (LIMS) soll über die HIT-Datenbank auf die von den Nutzern eingegebenen Informationen zu den Proben zugreifen können. Die IT-Anwendung muss daher über eine Schnittstelle zur HIT-Datenbank verfügen. Eine direkte Verbindung zum LIMS ist nicht vorgesehen. Die IT-Anwendung soll den Verwaltungsmitarbeitenden zur Abbildung verwaltungsinterner Vorgänge sowie betroffenen Nutzern außerhalb der Verwaltung zur Datenerfassung und Antragsstellung gegenüber sowie dem Empfang von Bescheiden von den zuständigen Behörden zur Verfügung stehen. Während die Anwendungsfälle Trichinenuntersuchung, Management von Monitoring-Proben im Tiergesundheitsbereich sowie die Schnittstelle zur Jagdstatistikanwendung dauerhaft zur Verfügung stehen sollen, soll der Anwendungsfall des Managements im Falle eines Ausbruches der Afrikanischen Schweinepest (ASP) nur anlassbezogen nutz- und verfügbar sein. Darüber hinaus soll auch eine Einführungsunterstützung sowie Schulung der Mitarbeitenden der zuständigen Behörden im Angebot als initiale Leistung enthalten sein. Vertragsschluss erfolgt über einen EVB-IT Cloud-Vertrag. Die Beschaffung erfolgt durch den Auftraggeber zur Nutzung durch alle Landkreise und kreisfreien Städte in Thüringen. Die Verwendung der IT-Anwendung für die vorgenannten Zwecke ist für die Landkreisen und kreisfreien Städten verpflichtend. Den Jägern ist die Verwendung dagegen freigestellt. Das bedeutet, diese können von der Verwendung der IT-Anwendung absehen. Das bisherige analoge System zur Probenahme wird vorerst parallel weitergeführt.

title: Poland – Engineering design services – Opracowanie dokumentacji dla zadania pn: „Budowa wschodniej obwodnicy miasta Biała Podlaska – etap II”.
description: 1. Przedmiotem zamówienia jest: Opracowanie dokumentacji dla zadania pn: „Budowa wschodniej obwodnicy miasta Biała Podlaska – etap II” zwanej dalej „Dokumentacją”. 2. Cel i podstawa opracowania. Celem zamówienia jest: a) Opracowanie wielobranżowej kompleksowej dokumentacji projektowej w stadium projektów budowlanych i wykonawczych wraz z dokumentacją geodezyjno-prawną, decyzjami oraz ze wszystkimi uzgodnieniami i opiniami, dla przedsięwzięcia wraz z zabezpieczeniem lub przebudową urządzeń obcych kolidujących z rozbudowywaną drogą i obiektami inżynierskimi, umożliwiającej uzyskanie decyzji o zezwoleniu na realizację inwestycji drogowej (decyzja ZRID) w trybie Ustawy z dnia 10 kwietnia 2003r. o szczególnych zasadach przygotowania i realizacji inwestycji w zakresie dróg publicznych wraz z uzyskaniem wymaganych ustawą opinii, przygotowaniem wniosku wraz ze wszystkimi wymaganymi załącznikami. Decyzję ZRID uzyskuje Zamawiający. b) Opracowanie materiałów i załączników, niezbędnych do uzyskania decyzji o środowiskowych uwarunkowaniach dla przedsięwzięcia wraz z jej uzyskaniem przez Wykonawcę. c) Opracowanie materiałów i uzyskanie załączników, niezbędnych do uzyskania stosownej zgody wodno-prawnej wraz z jej uzyskaniem przez Wykonawcę. d) Opracowanie materiałów niezbędnych do ogłoszenia i przeprowadzenia przetargu na wykonanie robót budowlanych, wymaganych przez Prawo Zamówień Publicznych i późniejszą realizację zadania. 3. Szczegółowy zakres przedmiotu zamówienia ujęty jest w „Opisie Przedmiotu Zamówienia” (dalej zwany „OPZ” stanowiącym załącznik do niniejszej SWZ). 4. Wykonawca zapewni Nadzór Autorski w czasie robót realizowanych na podstawie dokumentacji projektowej sporządzonej w oparciu o umowę oraz w zakresie określonym przez ustawę Prawo budowlane (art. 20 ust.1 pkt 4 ustawy oraz zgodnie z ustaleniami określonymi w Umowie. Pełnienie Nadzoru Autorskiego odbędzie się na zasadach prawa opcji w rozumieniu art. 441 ust.1 ustawy Prawo zamówień publicznych. Zlecenie wykonywania Nadzoru Autorskiego zależeć będzie od potrzeb Zamawiającego. 5. Zamawiający w OPZ określił, że przedmiot zamówienia, tj. projekt ma obejmować m.in. „Zniesienie ewentualnych barier architektonicznych w obrębie budowy / rozbudowy odcinka drogi wraz z obiektami inżynierskimi w celu zapewnienia dostępności dla wszystkich użytkowników, w szczególności dla osób niepełnosprawnych” (punkt II.1 ppkt. 14 OPZ), a tym samym jako obiekt publiczny po zrealizowaniu rozbudowy, nie będzie posiadał ograniczeń dostępności przez wszystkich uczestników ruchu drogowego, w tym przez osoby niepełnosprawne, do czego obligują przepisy dotyczące wymagań m.in. dla przepisów techniczno-budowlanych dotyczących dróg publicznych (j.t. Dz.U. z 2022 r. poz. 1518 z późn. zm.) oraz budynki i ich usytuowanie (j.t. Dz.U. z 2022 r. poz. 1225 z późn. zm.). 6. Zgodnie z art. 13 ust. 1 i 2 rozporządzenia Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych) (Dz. Urz. UE L 119 z 04.05.2016, str. 1), dalej „RODO”, informuję, że:  administratorem Pani/Pana danych osobowych jest Dyrektor ZDW w Lublinie, ul. Bohdana Dobrzańskiego 3, 20-262 Lublin; z inspektorem danych osobowych Zarządu Dróg Wojewódzkich w Lublinie można skontaktować się za pomocą e-maila: iod@zdw.lublin.pl Szczegółowe informacje dot. RODO znajdują się w dok.zamówienia. 7.Zamawiający, zgodnie z art. 139 ust. 1 ustawy pzp najpierw dokona badania i oceny ofert, a następnie dokona kwalifikacji podmiotowej Wykonawcy, którego oferta została najwyżej oceniona, w zakresie braku podstaw wykluczenia oraz spełnienia warunków udziału w postepowaniu. 8. W takim przypadku Zamawiający dokona badania i oceny ofert jedynie w zakresie ofert wariantowych 1. c) W przypadku, braku możliwości wyboru oferty podstawowej i oferty wariantowej 1, Zamawiający przeprowadzi badanie i ocenę spośród ofert wariantowych 2 lub unieważni postępowanie w przypadkach określonych przepisami Ustawy. W takim przypadku Zamawiający dokona badania i oceny ofert w zakresie jedynie ofert wariantowych 2.

title: Bulgaria – Cleaning and sanitation services – Почистване и хигиенизиране на помещенията на Изпълнителна агенция „Програма за образование“
description: Поръчката ще бъде изпълнявана в административна сграда, находяща се в гр. София, бул. „Цариградско шосе” № 125, блок 5. Сградата е пететажна със сутеренни помещения. Помещенията, в които е разположена ИАПО и които подлежат на почистване и хигиенизиране, се намират на първия етаж, част от втория етаж, част от третия етаж и едно помещение на петия етаж на сградата. Общата площ на помещенията, ползвани от ИАПО, е 2 034,09 кв.м. В обхвата на обществената поръчка е включено почистване и хигиенизиране на 49 работни кабинета (в т.ч. 3 директорски кабинети и 1 приемна /заседателна зала), 4 складови помещения, 3 санитарни помещения (включително 7 тоалетни), 3 коридора, 3 фоайета, стълбище и архив в сутерен с площ от 360 кв.м. Подовата настилка в кабинетите и заседателните зали е от паркет или ламинат – обща площ: 1 159,09 кв. м; Подовата настилка по коридорите и стълбищата е от мозайка – обща площ: 465 кв.м; Подовата настилка в санитарните помещения е от теракот – обща площ: 50 кв.м; Прозорците във всички помещения са с обща площ – 222,63 кв.м. Периодът за изпълнение на услугата е от 04.01.2027 г. до 31.12.2028 г. ВИДОВЕ ДЕЙНОСТИ, КОИТО ИЗПЪЛНИТЕЛЯТ СЛЕДВА ДА ИЗВЪРШВА: ЕЖЕДНЕВНИ ДЕЙНОСТИ ПО ХИГИЕНИЗИРАНЕ: 1. Измиване и дезинфекциране на санитарните възли – тоалетни, мивки, огледала, санитарна арматура, под, стени, врати, санитарен фаянс, санитарни аксесоари (диспенсъри, четки и поставки за четки за WC); 2. Изхвърляне на отпадъци от санитарните възли – 2 пъти дневно, единият от които в часовия диапазон 12:00 ч. – 14:00 ч.; 3. Измитане и измиване на твърдите подови настилки в работните кабинети; 4. Измитане и измиване на стълбища, фоайета и коридори; 5. Почистване на кошчетата в работните кабинети от смет и изхвърляне на боклук; 6. Зареждане на санитарните възли с консумативи (тоалетна трипластова хартия, хартиени кърпи за ръце, течен сапун) за всяка тоалетна - 2 пъти дневно, единият от които в часовия диапазон 12:00 ч. – 14:00 ч. В дейностите по т. 3 и 4 се включва и почистване, налагащо се при неочаквано замърсяване или при специален повод по указания на възложителя. ПЕРИОДИЧНИ (МЕСЕЧНИ) ДЕЙНОСТИ: 1. Почистване на складови помещения и архивни помещения – веднъж месечно; 2. Почистване на хладилник (1 брой) в помещение № 10– веднъж месечно (всеки последен петък от месеца); ДЕЙНОСТИ ПО ОСНОВНО ПОЧИСТВАНЕ: 1. Измиване на прозорци в работни и сервизни помещения, в това число и каси и дограма, стъклени и преградни стени – четири пъти за срока на договора; 2. Измиване на щори – два пъти за срока на договора; 3. Измиване на прозорци в общи помещения (входове, фоайета, стълбища и др.) - четири пъти за срока на договора; 4. Измиване на врати – четири пъти за срока на договора. description: Предметът на поръчката е: Изпълнение на строително-монтажни работи на обект: “Облагородяване на дворното пространство на Технологично училище „Електронни системи“ (ТУЕС) към Технически университет - София, изграждане на открити спортни игрища и дворна беседка за учебни дейности на открито. Обектът представлява дворното пространство на Техническо училище „Електронни системи“ към Технически университет. Съгласно Разрешението за строеж обектът е Първа Група, Четвърта Категория. Дворното пространство, предмет на този проект, е с площ от 7873 кв.м. Строително-монтажните работи, които са обект на поръчката обхващат следните части: Архитектурна /А/, Конструктивна /К/, Електроинсталации /ЕЛ/, Водоснабдяване и канализация /ВиК/, Паркоустройство и Геодезия. Целта на Инвеститора е да бъдат облагородени свободните пространства, като се изградят алеи и пешеходни зони, залесяване, изграждане на зони за отдих и разходка, районно осветление, ограда. Постигане на комплексно архитектурно – ландшафно въздействие на парковото пространство върху учебната среда. Повишаване на комфорта на обитаване извън сградното пространство на учебното заведение, с подобрена възможност за отдих и развлечения. Добавяне на специални акценти в парковото пространство с познавателна цел, както и стимулиране на учениците, чрез презентиране на върхови постижения в образователната дейност. За обекта има изготвен, съгласуван и одобрен, инвестиционен проект във фаза Технически проект по части: Архитектура, Конструкции, Геодезия, Водоснабдяване и канализация, Електрическа, Паркоустройство, Становище по част Пожарна безопасност. Строително – монтажните работи ще бъдат извършени в два последователни етапа: 1. Първи етап – В първия етап ще бъдат включени всички строително-монтажни дейности свързани с разкопаване, бетонови работи и изграждане на инфраструктура. В този етап ще бъде премахната съществуващата асфалтова настилка, за да бъде заменена с нова. Предвижда се разкопаване на земната основа около фундаментите на сградата, за да бъдат положени хидроизолация и дренажни тръби по детайли, приложени в проектите по част Архитектура и част ВиК. В зоната за спорт ще бъде изграден фонтан за питейна вода, който ще се захрани от съществуващата водопроводна мрежа на училището. При разкопаване на почвата ще се положат трасетата на електроснабдителната мрежа и ще се оформят местата за полагане на ревизионните шахти и стълбовете за осветление/видеонаблюдение, показани в проекта по част Електро. Ще бъде изцяло заменена оградата при уличната регулация – от всички страни на училището с изключение на страничната граница със съсед откъм северозапад - ПИ 68134.4082.69 – 17 ЦДГ Надежда. Оградата ще бъде изпълнена по конструктивен детайл с бетонов цокъл с височина 60см, на който ще бъдат положени метални колони и ажурни пана между тях. Към този етап от дейности се включва направата на фундаментите за сезонната беседка за учебни дейности на открито. Оградата около игрищата ще бъде изпълнена от метални колони, стъпващи върху ивични фундаменти по конструктивен детайл. Настилката при игрището за волейбол/баскетбол, фитнес зоната и правата писта е каучукова, за което е необходимо полагане на бетонова настилка по детайл, приложен в проекта по част Архитектура. Всички тези дейности изискват тежка механизация и разкопаване на дворното пространство, заради което трябва да бъдат изпълнени първо. 2. Втори етап – Паркоустройство и озеленяване, с изграждане на поливна система и вертикална планировка. В този етап ще се извършат довършителни дейности по облагородяването на двора, включващи: -полагане на каучуковата настилка при игрището за волейбол/баскетбол, фитнес зоната и правата писта; - изграждане на настилката с изкуствена трева по архитектурен детайл при футболното игрище; - подготвяне на основата и полагане на павираната настилка за алеите в зоната за отдих и дворната беседка за учебни дейности на открито; - изграждане на дворната беседка за учебни дейности на открито; - полагане на тръбите за капково напояване на необходимите места; - засаждане на растителността по проекта по част Паркоустройство. Срокът за изпълнение на строителството /срок за изпълнение на договорените строително–монтажни работи и предаването на строежа от ИЗПЪЛНИТЕЛЯ с Констативен акт Образец 15/ е до 150 (сто и петдесет) календарни дни. title: Romania – Construction supervision services – Servicii de supervizare a lucrărilor și Servicii de consultanță în managementul de proiect aferente proiectului: „REABILITARE LINII DE TRAMVAI POD ROȘ – ANASTASIE PANU” - SMIS 352728
description: Obiectul prezentului contract constă în Servicii de supervizare a lucrărilor și Servicii de consultanță în managementul de proiect pe parcursul implementării proiectului „Reabilitare linii de tramvai Pod Roș – Anastasie Panu”. Proiectul „Reabilitare linii de tramvai Pod Roș – Anastasie Panu” este compus din 2 obiecte: - Obiectul 1 - „Reabilitare linii de tramvai Pod Roș – Anastasie Panu”, respectiv - Obiectul 2 - „Extindere cale de rulare tramvai Pod Roș – Anastasie Panu”. În cadrul obiectului 1 - „Reabilitare linii de tramvai Pod Roș – Anastasie Panu”, se propune reabilitarea infrastructurii și suprastructurii căii de rulare tramvai, pe tronsonul cuprins între Pod Roș și strada Anastasie Panu până la intersecția cu strada Sfântul Lazăr. În cadrul obiectului 2 - „Extindere cale de rulare tramvai Pod Roș – Anastasie Panu”, se propune extinderea liniei de tramvai din Podu Roș pe tronsonul cuprins între intersecția străzii Palat cu strada Sfântul Lazăr, respectiv strada Sfântul Lazăr cu strada Anastasie Panu. Obiectivul general al proiectului îl reprezintă reducerea emisiilor de carbon în municipiile reședință de județ prin investiții bazate pe planurile de mobilitate urbană. Obiectivele principale sunt reabilitarea infrastructurii și suprastructurii căii de rulare tramvai pe tronsonul cuprins între Pod Roș și strada Anastasie Panu până la intersecția cu strada Sfântul Lazăr și extinderea infrastructurii și suprastructurii căii de rulare tramvai pe tronsonul cuprins între Pod Roș - strada Sfântul Lazăr intersecție cu strada Anastasie Panu din Municipiul Iași. Ca urmare a corelării celor două obiective se propune: - reabilitarea infrastructurii și suprastructurii căii de rulare tramvai, pe tronsonul cuprins între Podu Roș și strada Anastasie Panu - din Municipiul Iași prin transformarea străzii Anastasie Panu (de la intersecția cu strada Sf. Lazăr) și străzii Palat în stradă cu sens unic de coborâre spre Podu Roș ce va include banda dedicată de coborâre pentru autobuze și tramvaie; - mutarea firului aferent al sensului de coborâre al tramvaiului, sensul strada Anastasie Panu – Strada Palat – Podu Roș la bordură; - firul aferent sensului de urcare va avea traseul Podu Roș – Strada Sf. Lazăr – Pasaj pietonal Sf. Vineri (intersecție Str. Sf. Lazăr cu Str. Anastasie Panu), - desființarea căii de rulare de pe strada Piața Palat și amenajarea acesteia ca pietonal; - înființare cale simplă de rulare pe strada Sfântul Lazăr, poziționată pe partea stângă a străzii, lângă bordură. Durata de execuție: 32 luni perioada de implementare de la data semnării acestuia. În cazuri justificate pentru perioadele de prelungire a obiectului contractului, Beneficiarul va elabora un act adiţional la Contract, fără o suplimentare a bugetului alocat. Prelungirea duratei contractului se va putea realiza, în cazuri justificate, prin act adițional, fără depășirea perioadei de eligibilitate a cheltuielilor stabilită prin Programul Regional Nord-Est 2021-2027. Contractul este finanțat prin Programul Regional Nord-Est 2021–2027, Prioritatea 4 – „O regiune cu o mobilitate urbană mai durabilă”, fiind supus rigorilor de raportare și vizibilitate specifice fondurilor FEDR și principiului DNSH („Do No Significant Harm”). Orice operator economic interesat are dreptul de a solicita clarificări sau informații suplimentare în legătură cu documentația de atribuire, cu respectarea termenului-limită stabilit de entitatea contractantă. Numărul de zile până la care operatorii economici pot solicita clarificări privind documentația de atribuire înainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor: 21 zile. Autoritatea contractanta va răspunde doar la solicitările de clarificări adresate de operatorii economici pana la termenul-limita stabilit, si anume 14 zile înainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor. Autoritatea contractanta stabilește un singur termen limita in care va răspunde tuturor solicitărilor de clarificări/informații suplimentare.

ДДС Обособена позиция №15 Апаратура марка Haier – Прогнозна стойност 3 000,00 € без вкл. ДДС Общата прогнозна стойност на настоящата обществена поръчка за срока й на изпълнение е 68 172, 25 евро ( шестдесет и осем хиляди сто седемдесет и две евро и двадесет и пет евроцента) без вкл. ДДС и е максимално допустима, като възложителя се лимитира с нея, но не се обвързва да я изчерпи. Минималният брой сервизни часове (включително часовете за профилактика) за обособени позиции, за които Възложителят е предвидил заплащане за извънгаранционно сервизно обслужване при необходимост, са описани в Колона № 12 от Общата техническа спецификация. Максимално допустимата стойност по всяка обособена позиция (максимално допустима цена за сервизно обслужване при необходимост), предвидени от Възложителя е описана в Колона № 9 и 10 от Общата техническа спецификация, като възложителя се лимитира с нея, но не се обвързва да я изчерпи. Срокът за изпълнение на обществената поръчка е 2 (две) години, но не по-късно от посочената крайна дата, съгласно Проекта на договор и Техническата спецификация - 31.10.2028 год. включително. При договор, сключен за повече с повече от една номенклатурна единица по обособената позиция, договорът може да влиза в сила по различно време за всяка от тях, в зависимост от посоченото в Приложенията към техническата спецификация и е със срок на действие до 31.10.2028 г. вкл. Доставката на резервни части не е предмет на настоящата обществена поръчка и стойността им не е включена в посочената прогнозна стойност. Съгласно чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП, Възложителят има право да възлага обособени позиции по реда валиден за индивидуалната стойност на всяка от тях, при условие, че стойността на съответната обособена позиция не надхвърля 79 998,77 евро за доставки и услуги и общата прогнозна стойност на обособените позиции, възложени по този начин, не надхвърля 20 на сто от общата стойност на поръчката. В тези случаи независимо от остатъчната стойност на поръчката тя се възлага по реда, приложим към общата прогнозна стойност на цялата поръчка. Имайки предвид горното, прогнозната стойност на обособените позиции с номера 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9, които Възложителят предвижда да възложи по реда на чл.74 от ЗОП е 54 672,25 евро без включен ДДС, като същата представлява 80,20 % от общата стойност на поръчката. Прогнозната стойност на обособените позиции с номера 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 е 13 500,00 евро без включен ДДС, като същата представлява 19,80% от общата стойност на поръчката и стойността на всяка обособена позиция попада в приложното поле на чл. 20, ал. 4, т. 3 от ЗОП. С оглед изложеното и на основание чл. 21, ал. 6 от ЗОП, обособени позиции с номера 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15 ще бъдат възложени по реда на чл. 20, ал. 4, т. 3 от ЗОП, а именно чрез директно възлагане. title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source: Mission Termination System (MTS) to Autonomy Government Reference Architecture (A-GRA) Software Upgrade
description: The Department of the Air Force, Air Force Test Center (AFTC), Support Service Branch (PZZF) at Edwards Air Force Base, CA, intends to award a sole-source, standalone Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract for software development and systems integration services to modify the government-owned Mission Termination System (MTS). The core objective is to design, integrate, and test an Autonomy Government Reference Architecture (A-GRA) compatible interface service and message processor natively within the existing MTS flight-test safety watchdog architecture. This project will deliver a certified Technology Readiness Level 9 (TRL 9) product enabling Software-in-the-Loop (SITL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL), and live flight testing of autonomously controlled Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) and Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) at the 412 TENG Experimental Test Force (ETF). 2. SOLE SOURCE AUTHORITY The proposed acquisition will be conducted under the simplified acquisition procedures of Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 13.1, as authorized by RFO 13.106-1(b)(1), Soliciting from a Single Source. The Government intends to award this requirement as a sole-source contract to: Proposed Contractor: Weather Gage Technologies, LLC (WGT) CAGE Code: 7U9F7 Socioeconomic Status: Small Veteran-Owned Business Address: 2709 Thyme Dr, Edgewater, MD 21037 3. TECHNICAL JUSTIFICATION & MARKET RESEARCH FINDINGS Comprehensive market research conducted under RFO Part 10 has determined that Weather Gage Technologies is the only commercial source capable of satisfying this requirement without the Government incurring unacceptable technical, safety-of-flight, and schedule risks. Unique Technical Expertise: The MTS is a highly specialized Run Time Assurance (RTA) safety watchdog built upon the Testing Autonomy in Complex Environments (TACE) codebase originally developed by Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory (JHU APL). WGT possesses proprietary codebases, custom interface design patterns, and certified testing experience on this exact architecture. Prior Proven Navy Performance: WGT successfully designed and integrated similar A-GRA interfaces on an MTS variant for U.S. Navy test partners under contract N68335-26-C-0206. WGT's existing design patterns cannot be replicated by other entities without a complete, bottom-up redesign of the safety software. GSA eBuy RFI Results: A formal Request for Information (RFI1825881) was issued on GSA eBuy to Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) Category 54151S to assess broader market capability. Out of 30 qualified vendors, 28 submitted formal "No Bid" responses, one submitted a non-conforming capability statement at $0.00, and one vendor submitted an unviable, highly inflated estimate of $2,558,560.00 (more than 27 times the estimated program value). WGT did not submit a GSA eBuy bid and has confirmed they maintain no authorized third-party resellers or strategic schedule partners. Interagency Non-Viability: NAWCAD procurement officials have formally confirmed that the Navy's SBIR Phase II contract cannot be leveraged by outside agencies, requiring the Air Force to execute a standalone open-market purchase order directly to the sole source. Any other developer attempting this integration would require a lengthy learning curve to master the TACE codebase, resulting in severe delays to active CCA test programs, estimated at several hundreds of thousands of dollars in redundant engineering and safety certification costs. 4. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTES This publication is for informational purposes only and does not constitute a formal Request for Proposal (RFP) or Request for Quote (RFQ). No solicitation package is available. However, in accordance with RFO Part 5, any interested party that believes it possesses the technical capability to meet this requirement may submit a written capability statement. Capability statements must provide clear, documented evidence of the vendor's prior engineering experience with the TACE/MTS safety watchdog codebase and A-GRA compliance. All submissions received within five (5) calendar days of the publication of this notice will be evaluated solely for the purpose of determining whether a competitive procurement is in the best interest of the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Contracting Officer. Points of Contact Contract Specialist: Josiah L. Broadway Email: josiah.broadway@us.af.mil Contracting Officer: Christina M. Day Email: christina.day.6@us.af.mil

title: NX EQ SAFE LABEL PRINTER FOR OPERATING ROOM MEDICATIONS
description: This Notice of Intent to Sole Source is not a request for competitive quotations or proposals. The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Enterprise Procurement Office (EPO), intends to negotiate and award a firm?fixed?price sole?source Requirements contract, in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhual (RFO) 6.103?1 for the procurement of Codonics� Safe Label Systems� (SLS) and associated equipment with Codonics�, Inc., 17991 Englewood Drive, Middleburg Heights, OH 44130. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 339112, Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing, is the most appropriate for this requirement. The size standard is 1,000 employees. The Product Service Code (PSC) is 6515, Medical and Surgical Instruments, Equipment, and Supplies. The statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition is 41 U.S.C.3304(a)(1) as implemented by the Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 6.103-1 entitled, �Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements�, as implemented by VAAR Part 806. Interested parties may identify their interest and capability to meet this requirement. Any response must include sufficient detail to demonstrate the ability to provide all line items described below. No solicitation is available, and telephone requests will not be accepted. Responses received will be reviewed; however, a determination by the Government not to compete this requirement is based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. No cost to the government will arise as a result of contractor submissions of responses to this announcement or the government use of such information. Requirement Description The VA requires safe label printers for medication products for use in operating rooms (OR), anesthesia locations, and pharmacies. These products must support safe medication identification and administration during anesthesia care and meet clinical requirements unique to the perioperative environment, where medication errors present an immediate and significant risk to Veteran safety. Safe Label Printers for OR medications are the standard of care in hospital settings. Safe Label Printers for OR medications are U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Class II medical devices that improve the safety and accuracy of medication management and labeling compliance. Safe Label Printers are utilized in ORs with anesthesia drug carts to electronically identify the drugs. These printers use visual and audible confirmation based on the Numerical Electromagnetics Code 2 (NEC2) of the vial/ampoule provides the clinicians with real-time safety checks to eliminate medication errors. Safe Label Printers for OR medication system provide Joint Commission compliant labels. The main purpose of the system is to eliminate common drug errors and meet the Institute for Safe Medication Practices (ISMP) Guidelines for Safe Medication Use.

The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Enterprise Procurement Office (EPO), intends to negotiate and award a firm?fixed?price sole?source Requirements contract, in accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhual (RFO) 6.103?1 for the procurement of Codonics� Safe Label Systems� (SLS) and associated equipment with Codonics�, Inc., 17991 Englewood Drive, Middleburg Heights, OH 44130. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 339112, Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing, is the most appropriate for this requirement. The size standard is 1,000 employees. The Product Service Code (PSC) is 6515, Medical and Surgical Instruments, Equipment, and Supplies. The statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition is 41 U.S.C.3304(a)(1) as implemented by the Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 6.103-1 entitled, �Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements�, as implemented by VAAR Part 806. Any response must include sufficient detail to demonstrate the ability to provide all line items described below. No solicitation is available, and telephone requests will not be accepted. Responses received will be reviewed; however, a determination by the Government not to compete this requirement is based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. No cost to the government will arise as a result of contractor submissions of responses to this announcement or the government use of such information. Requirement Description The VA requires safe label printers for medication products for use in operating rooms (OR), anesthesia locations, and pharmacies. These products must support safe medication identification and administration during anesthesia care and meet clinical requirements unique to the perioperative environment, where medication errors present an immediate and significant risk to Veteran safety. Safe Label Printers for OR medications are the standard of care in hospital settings. Safe Label Printers for OR medications are U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Class II medical devices that improve the safety and accuracy of medication management and labeling compliance. Safe Label Printers are utilized in ORs with anesthesia drug carts to electronically identify the drugs. These printers use visual and audible confirmation based on the Numerical Electromagnetics Code 2 (NEC2) of the vial/ampoule provides the clinicians with real-time safety checks to eliminate medication errors. Safe Label Printers for OR medication system provide Joint Commission compliant labels. The main purpose of the system is to eliminate common drug errors and meet the Institute for Safe Medication Practices (ISMP) Guidelines for Safe Medication Use.

title: Barracks Maintenance OTA
description: 1. INTRODUCTION & SYNOPSIS This announcement is a formal Request for Prototype Proposal (RPP) issued by the Mission & Installation Contracting Command (MICC) � Fort Campbell on behalf of the Directorate of Public Works (DPW) at Fort Campbell, Kentucky. The Government is seeking competitive prototype proposals to design, integrate, and execute a modernized facility management solution across 58 unaccompanied housing (barracks) facilities. The prototype will integrate an advanced, secure Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) software platform with cross-trained physical maintenance execution to streamline work order triage, optimize Between Occupancy Maintenance (BOM), and execute proactive Preventative Maintenance Orders (PMO). Authority: 10 U.S.C. � 4022, Other Transaction Authority (OTA) for Prototype Projects. Agreement Type: The Government intends to award a single Other Transaction (OT) agreement. Follow-on Production / Sustainment: Offerors are advised that in accordance with 10 U.S.C. � 4022(f), successful completion of this prototype project may result in the award of a non-competitive, follow-on production/sustainment agreement or contract without further competition. 2. BACKGROUND Fort Campbell DPW is responsible for maintaining unaccompanied housing infrastructure that directly impacts Soldier readiness and Quality of Life (QoL). The current operating model relies heavily on manual administrative workflows, disparate tracking mechanisms, and reactive maintenance practices, leading to extended vacancy timelines during unit rotations, misdiagnosed service dispatches, and increased facility wear. This prototype project seeks to validate a modernized operational model that combines commercial best practices with enterprise Army platforms (including integration with ArMA, GFEBS, and the forthcoming enterprise IBM Maximo migration). Key modernization elements include QR-code-enabled request intake, automated work order routing, decentralized parts staging solutions (e.g., smart lockers), and dual-track maintenance (physical inspections for legacy systems and sensor-based monitoring for modern equipment). 3. ELIGIBILITY This RPP is open to all responsible business entities. In accordance with 10 U.S.C. � 4022(d)(1), an award may only be made if at least one of the following conditions is met: At least one nontraditional defense contractor or small business participates to a significant extent in the prototype project; OR All significant participants in the transaction other than the Federal Government are small businesses or nontraditional defense contractors; OR At least one-third (1/3) of the total cost of the prototype project is to be paid out of funds provided by sources other than the Federal Government (cost share); OR The Senior Procurement Executive provides written approval for exceptional circumstances. 4. PROPOSAL SUBMISSION & KEY DATES Proposal Instructions: Interested Offerors shall submit a comprehensive proposal package consisting of: Technical Approach (addressing EAM integration, physical maintenance, and predictive monitoring) Integrated Logistics & Sustainability Plan (addressing supply chain, SOPs, and knowledge transfer) Management, Programmatic, & Lifecycle Approach (Integrated Master Schedule, risk management, and scaling) Cost / Price Proposal Performance Work Statement (PWS) (directly derived from Attachment 001, Statement of Objectives) Key Dates: Questions Due Date: Sep 16, 2026, at 11:00 AM Central Time (CT) Site Visit Date: Sep 17, 2026, at 10:00 AM CT Proposal Due Date: Sep 25, 2026, at 11:00 AM Central Time (CT) Submission Instructions: Method: All questions and proposals must be submitted electronically via email. Email Address: evan.m.rea.civ@army.mil 5. GOVERNMENT POINTS OF CONTACT (POCs) Agreements Officer (AO): Eric C. Boston (eric.c.boston.civ@army.mil) Agreements Specialist / Contract Specialist: Evan M. Rea (evan.m.rea.civ@army.mil)

title: RD - Opravy a servis DANTHERM V-AM 40 a V-AM 15 12/2026 - 11/2030
description: RD - Opravy a servis DANTHERM V-AM 40 a V-AM 15 v období 1. 12. 2026 - 30. 11. 2030. Požadujeme řádné vyplnění návrhu RD (musí být podepsán) a přílohy č. 1 - Spotřební koš (vyplnit vše zažlucené). title: Postroje pro psy s balistickou ochranou
description: Nákup postrojů pro psy s balistickou ochranou Součásti nabídky bude vyplněný a podepsaný Návrh smlouvy (vše vyžlucené). Návrh smlouvy musí být podepsán. Podmínkou účasti v zadávacím řízení je doložení čestného prohlášení o tom, že v okamžiku předání zboží kupujícímu nebudou komponenty a materiály použité k výrobě zboží starší 12 měsíců. Podáním nabídky a podpisem návrhu smlouvy prodávající vyjadřuje souhlas s celým jejím obsahem včetně příloh.

title: Stavební opravy na b.č.19, 91 a 257, Město Libavá
description: Provedení stavebních oprav na budovách č. 19, 91 a 257 ve vojenském areálu Město Libavá , s cílem zajištění řádného stavebně technického stavu objektů. Realizace prací, činností a dodávek související s provedením výše označeného díla, týkající se opravy vnějších a vnitřních omítek, maleb a nátěrů, keramických obkladů, dlažeb a litých podlah, drobné zednické práce, oprava vnitřní kanalizace, vodovodu a zařizovacích předmětů, klempířských, zámečnických, tesařských a truhlářských konstrukcí, opravy elektroinstalace, sádrokartonových konstrukcí, venkovního betonového schodiště, opravy vrstev střešní konstrukce a krytiny a s tím související zemní práce, demontáže a bourací práce, přesuny hmot, lešení, dokončovací a zakrývací práce a úklid, zajištění likvidace vzniklého odpadu v souladu s platnými právními předpisy a zařízení staveniště po dobu opravy. Provedení všech potřebných zkoušek a revizí ověřující řádné provedení díla a prokazujících bezpečný provoz a funkčnost díla, předání všech dokladů a předvedení provedeného díla při jeho předání objednateli.

title: Long-Duration Energy Storage (LDES) Battery System
description: INTRODUCTION Idaho National Laboratory (INL) and Argonne National Laboratory (ANL) are seeking information from organizations that can provide long-duration energy storage (LDES) battery systems for benchmark performance testing at National Laboratory facilities. This EOI aims to identify qualified technologies and suppliers, inform technical planning, and refine subsequent acquisition steps. BACKGROUND Idaho National Laboratory (INL) and Argonne National Laboratory (ANL) are seeking LDES technologies that will undergo benchmark performance testing at their facilities. Acceptable technologies include rechargeable electrochemical battery systems that: Can be configured into a module dimension, namely, 100-150 kWh, that can sustain 10-15 kW over ten hours. LxWxH shall not exceed 7x7x7 ft. Two such modules are sought. Can be configured into a full-size dimension, namely, 1000-1500 kWh, that can sustain 100-150 kW over ten hours. Anticipated dimension is one 40-ft shipping container, or two 20-ft containers. One such full-size system is sought. Can be operated between 0 to 50 �C without more than 20% loss in power performance and 20% more aging (energy capacity loss) than that observed at a baseline condition of operating at 25 �C. Provide an AC/DC interface that facilitates testing and logging of all system parameters, Will arrive at INL and ANL sites as pre-built systems, with only minor connections required prior to operation, has a lifetime under typical field conditions of no less than fifteen (15) years (lifetime estimate basis to be disclosed). It is required that data acquired from INL and ANL testing will be available for publication. Unacceptable technologies include: Lithium-ion, Lithium metal, Lead-acid, Redox flow batteries, any non-rechargeable system, any non-electrochemical system, any system requiring on-site fabrication, any system lacking sufficient durability in typical field conditions (<15 yr). SCOPE OF WORK These requirements define the minimum technical, safety, performance, and documentation expectations for acceptable long duration energy storage (LDES) systems. The system shall be capable of providing at least 10" hours� of continuous discharge at rated power and exporting both AC and DC power. Technology & Duration System must deliver ?10 hours at rated power under nominal conditions. Offeror must describe the non?lithium electrochemical technology, provide technical evidence (test data, certifications, field deployments), and outline any operational constraints. Provide dimensions, weight, expected lifetime, and fully burdened cost for module?scale and full?scale systems. Rated Power & Energy Modules: ?10 kW continuous power; ?100 kWh usable energy (10 hours). Bidirectional charging/discharging within stated environmental limits. Specify rated power/energy, overload capability, and electrical operating ranges. Full?Scale System: ?100 kW continuous power; ?1,000 kWh usable energy (10 hours). Bidirectional operation; same specification requirements as modules. AC/DC Interface & Controls AC interface: 3?phase, 60 Hz, 480 VAC; include single?line diagram and protection/connection requirements. DC interface: isolated export; 800�1500 VDC; specify current rating, transient behavior, grounding/isolation, converter needs. Preferred multi?port inverter providing simultaneous AC/DC power. Provide monitoring metrics, control interfaces, SCADA protocol support (Modbus TCP/IP, DNP3, IEC 61850), and Interface Control Document (ICD). Safety, Compliance & Hazard Mitigation Must meet NFPA 855, UL 9540/9540A (or equivalent), NEC/IEEE standards. Provide certifications or plan to obtain them. Submit hazard assessment (chemical, thermal, fire, explosion, environmental). Required safety systems: electrical protections, fire detection/notification, proper labeling/signage. Preferred: emergency stop, external alarm signaling/suppression. Include emergency response instructions. Performance, Availability & Degradation At commissioning, system must deliver rated power for ?10 hours. Specify initial and end?of?period usable capacity, round?trip efficiency, and availability target (?95% recommended). Provide maintenance intervals, corrective response times, and recommended spare parts. Degradation model preferred. Documentation, Testing & Support Provide 70%, 90%, and final design packages for module and full-scale systems. Conduct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT); submit reports. Provide operation/maintenance manuals and preventative maintenance plan (delivered ?1 month before system delivery). Include remote monitoring and full project-period support, including troubleshooting and decommissioning support. Schedule, Delivery & Commissioning Provide full project schedule (design through testing). Modules delivered to INL within ~3 months of final design acceptance; full?scale system delivered to ANL within ~6 months. Perform onsite commissioning (inspection, energization, testing, controls configuration, safety verification). SAT completion preferred within 1 month of installation; system becomes available only after ANL formal acceptance. PROCESS This EOI is the first step in identifying interested and qualified vendors for future solicitation. Responses may be used to inform the development of a formal solicitation list. Selected vendors may be invited to participate in a Request for Proposal (RFP) process for award consideration. SUBMITTAL REQUIREMENTS Interested vendors must submit a single consolidated PDF or Word document containing: NAICS code and business size classification Cover letter with organization name, point of contact, and summary of proposed LDES technology Technology description (chemistry, architecture, evidence of ?10?hour discharge) Physical characteristics (dimensions/weight of modules and full?scale systems; installation/shipping details Interfaces (AC single?line diagram; DC specifications; supported communication protocols) Safety & compliance documentation (NFPA/UL/NEC/IEEE; hazard assessment; emergency response guidance; safety systems) Performance data (rated power/energy, round?trip efficiency, availability target, degradation model) Expected lifetime of system under vendor-specified field-type conditions, and basis for lifetime estimate (data, models, etc.). Operations & maintenance plan (maintenance intervals, spares, monitoring capability, support) Project schedule (design, manufacturing, delivery, commissioning/testing milestones) Commercials (indicative pricing for module and full-scale systems; warranty/support terms) Deadline for submission: September 24, 2026 Submit to: Chase.Egbert@inl.gov Only select respondents, as determined by BEA, will receive an invitation to participate in the anticipated RFP solicitation. PROPRIETARY INFORMATION Because information received in response to this EOI may be business sensitive or proprietary to the responding party, respondents must mark information in their responses accordingly.

title: SR-1 Freedom Reactor Radiation Shielding Design/Build
description: I. Introduction Battelle Energy Alliance, LLC (BEA), Management & Operating Contractor of the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) owned Idaho National Laboratory (INL). BEA is collaborating with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) to develop the SR-1 Freedom interplanetary spacecraft. BEA is seeking an Expression of Interest (EOI) from prospective offerors to support design/build of the SR-1 Freedom Reactor Radiation Shielding system (RRS). II. PROCESS BEA is seeking qualified firms to compete for the design/build contract in support of the BEA/NASA SR-1 Freedom RRS system. As determined by BEA, responders to this EOI may receive a Request for Proposal (RFP) that will require detailed technical and price proposals be provided for evaluation and ranking under a source selection process. Interested firms are advised that RFP release is anticipated late September/early October 2026 and the source selection/award decision is anticipated in October 2026. The contract award type will be firm-fixed price. The design/build contract will be awarded in progressive phases as the firms demonstrate the ability and competency to successfully plan, design, and fabricate the RRS. BEA may initially award multiple Design/Build contracts to various firms though the Design phase to make a final determination of which firm will continue with the fabrication. Completion of this project must be no later than July 2027. III. PROJECT DESCRIPTION The RRS will be designed and fabricated for the SR-1 Nuclear Power Module (NPM) SR-1 Freedom which will be built at the Materials and Fuels Complex (MFC) at the INL. MFC is located approximately 33 miles west of Idaho Falls, Idaho. The RRS system will provide radiation shielding for various components of the spacecraft from the nuclear reactor neutron and gamma photon radiation. The composite weight of the RRS will need to be less than 1200 kg and interface with face four separate NPM systems: The reactor structure Control drum actuators The Heat Management System (HMS) heat pipes Power Conversion System (PCS) structure The RRS system and materials will need to operate in the vacuum of space at temperatures ranging from space ambient temperature of -273�C to 800 �C when in proximity to the reactor and HMS heat pipes. The RRS system and materials will need to be designed, tested, and qualified to withstand the launch forces and vibrations associated with launch into space as well as the operation environment described above. The RRS must provide adequate radiation shielding for various SR-1 Freedom systems, structures, and components, and prescribed gamma photon total ionizing dose limits and fast neutron fluences limits. The RRS is positioned between the reactor and the PCS. The HMS transfers heat from the reactor via several dozen heat pipes to the PCS to convert the heat energy into electrical energy. In addition to the penetrations for the HMS heat pipes, the RRS must accommodate penetrations for the rods of the control drum actuators, located on the PCS side, which pass through the RRS and into the reactor. Specific dimensions, configurations, reactor characteristics, dose limits, etc., may be considered export controlled information and will not be provided in this expression of interest. A general layout of the RRS and interfacing systems is provided below. IV. Submittal Interested firms are requested to provide expressions of interest to the undersigned by close-of business on September 24, 2026. Included must be sufficient written information confirming the responder�s qualifications addressing each of the following criteria: Experience in radiation shielding material design and fabrication. Radiation transport modeling or equivalent shielding analysis. Capability to meet the design/build schedule. Capability to provide and fabricate the shielding components in the needed geometries. Proper identification and execution plan for material testing & qualification. Agreement to have a documented quality program that is consistent with the guidelines of ISO 9001-2015 and ANSI/ASQC C1-1996 General Requirements for a Quality Program. Be capable of meeting QA audit requirements to be added to the INL QSL. Note that responses must be no more than 20 pages in length. Only potentially qualified offerors, as determined by BEA, will receive the RFP for the project. If you have questions, need additional information, or need to speak with a BEA Point of Contact, please contact Chase Egbert via email at chase.egbert@inl.gov . Technical questions must be submitted in writing via email.

title: Weißenburg i. Bay., Schwärzgasse 1, 410-Sanitärinstallation
description: Sanitär An der Agentur für Arbeit in Weißenburg wurden Mängel an der Trinkwasserinstallation festgestellt. Insbesondere wurden u.a. erhöhte Eisenwerte im Trinkwasser festgestellt, die auf eine fortgeschrittene Korrosion der bestehenden Trinkwasser-Rohrleitungen aus verzinktem Stahlrohr schließen lassen. Entsprechend sollen im ersten Abschnitt die Trinkwasserleitungen inkl. Einbauten im Kellergeschoss ausgetauscht werden. Im Anschluss (separate Ausschreibung) sollen die verbliebenen Leitungen mit einer abschnittsweisen Spülung mit Luft/ Wasser Gemisch gereinigt und einer Sanierungsdosierung anschließend der Korrosionsschutz hergestellt werden.
